$comment: Machine-readable delta registry for hermes-agent. Every change we carry on top of the pinned upstream tag lives here with the reason and the condition under which it can be dropped; hermes-upstream-check.mjs compares it against upstream and flags the deltas upstream has caught up with. Docs: docs/myrmidon/hermes-deltas.md. Keep pinnedRef/pinnedVersion in sync with docker/bot-runtime/Dockerfile (the checker fails when they disagree).

hindsightPlugin.$comment: The memory provider we vendor, recorded here (not read from a file: the hermes catalog entry lives inside the hermes checkout, not in this repository). The image reads plugin-catalog/hindsight.yaml from the pinned hermes tag and fails the build when this pin disagrees; the checker probes the plugin's own default branch.

deltas.reason: The bash session snapshot lives in a shared temp dir and every profile in a container runs as one uid, so credential-shaped env values dumped there were readable by a neighbouring profile.
deltas.dropCondition: Upstream excludes credential-shaped env names from the session snapshot by itself.
deltas.offerNote: Not offered yet: publishing to a third-party repository needs the publisher-scan wrapper (plan item PUBLISH-SCAN), which does not exist; the text is prepared in the ticket for the operator to submit.

deltas.reason: Two concurrent runs of one agent (a writer and a session-history reader) made the reader fail with "database is locked": the read path replayed only "disk I/O error".
deltas.dropCondition: Upstream retries a locked read in _read_retrying_ioerr.
deltas.offerNote: Not offered yet: see the note on delta 02 (publisher-scan wrapper pending).

deltas.reason: The stock asyncio default executor is small and a live run holds one worker for its whole life, so the board's POST /v1/runs create calls timed out behind parallel runs.
deltas.dropCondition: Upstream sizes the gateway's default executor above the fleet's concurrent runs, or ships an equivalent setting.
deltas.offerNote: Not offered yet: see the note on delta 02 (publisher-scan wrapper pending).

deltas.reason: The catalog Hindsight plugin uses one shared client timeout for recall, retain and reflect, and has no way to skip the expensive consolidated-observations layer; a reflect call routinely outlives a recall-sized timeout. The in-tree provider we used to patch had a reflect-specific timeout, a fact-type filter and a bounded retry on the bank's 503 admission refusal.
deltas.dropCondition: The catalog plugin gains a reflect-specific timeout (or a per-operation timeout), a reflect fact-type filter, or the 503 retry.
deltas.offerNote: Not offered yet: the change is small and self-contained but publishing to a third-party repository needs the publisher-scan wrapper (plan item PUBLISH-SCAN) first; the offer text is prepared in the ticket for the operator.
